settings.title: How to apply
settings.text:
1. Clean and dry your nails. Push back cuticles and buff lightly.
  2. Match a press-on to each nail before you start.
  3. Add a thin layer of nail glue to your nail and to the press-on.
  4. Press it on at an angle from the cuticle, then hold firmly.

Takes about [apply_minutes] minutes.

settings.title: Removal
settings.text:
1. Soak your nails in warm soapy water for a few minutes.
  2. Gently lift each press-on from the side. Never pull.
  3. Clean off any glue and keep the set for next time.

settings.title: How long do they last?
settings.text: Reusable for about [wear_count] wears with gentle removal. That's about Rs [cost_per_wear] a wear.

settings.title: When will it ship?
settings.text: Each set is hand-painted to order and dispatched in [dispatch_time].

settings.heading: Pair it with a second set
settings.text: Two sets come with a free nail glue remover.
